faculty.name: Dr. Animesh Halder
faculty.degrees: Ph.D. in Applied Optics & Photonics (Calcutta Univ), M.Tech in Bioelectronics (Tezpur Univ)
faculty.almaMater: University of Calcutta | Tezpur Univ | Formerly Scientist C at SNBNCBS & C-DAC
faculty.specialization: Biomedical Instrumentation, Non-Invasive Medical Devices, Applied Optics & Bio-AI
faculty.bio: Dr. Animesh Halder is an accomplished academic and technologist with over 14 years of experience bridging higher education, applied research, and national-level technology initiatives. He serves as the Program-In-Charge of the Biomedical Engineering Program and Assistant Professor-III at Adamas University, and is the Founder of the BioAlgorithm Lab, where he advances affordable, data-driven medical devices and connected healthcare solutions. Previously, he served as Scientist C at the S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences and Project Manager / Senior Project Engineer at C-DAC New Delhi, leading translational health projects, patented non-invasive point-of-care devices (such as neonatal bilirubinometers and fluid electrolyte monitors), and successful technology transfers to clinical and industrial stakeholders. He holds a Ph.D. in Applied Optics & Photonics from the University of Calcutta and an M.Tech in Bioelectronics from Tezpur University.
researchFocus: Bio-AI, Machine Learning & Clinical Data Analysis

faculty.name: Dr. Sayanti Chaudhuri
faculty.degrees: Ph.D. in Electrical Engg (Jadavpur Univ), M.E. in Biomedical Engg (Jadavpur Univ)
faculty.almaMater: Jadavpur University | Calcutta Institute of Engg & Management (WBUT)
faculty.specialization: Acoustic Signal Processing, Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Bio-Signals & Embedded Systems
faculty.bio: Dr. Sayanti Chowdhury (Chaudhuri) is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Biomedical Engineering at Adamas University, Kolkata. With over a decade of combined academic, research, and laboratory mentoring experience, her expertise centers on digital signal processing (DSP), acoustic signal processing, embedded systems, and AI/ML algorithms for audio and bio-signal enhancement. She holds a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering and an M.E. in Biomedical Engineering from Jadavpur University, along with a B.Tech in Instrumentation & Control Engineering. Previously, she served as a doctoral researcher and teaching assistant at Jadavpur University, and as a Senior Research Fellow at the National Institute for the Orthopaedically Handicapped (NIOH), Kolkata, where she developed an indigenous pressure-sensing gait analyzer. Her research has been published in high-impact international journals including IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics, Measurement, and Biomedical Engineering Letters.

researchTracks.title: Biomedical Instrumentation & Signal Processing
researchTracks.subtitle: Biosensors, Medical Imaging, Diagnostic Systems & Electrophysiology
researchTracks.description: Focuses on designing next-generation electronic sensors, microfluidic chips, and advanced physiological signal processing algorithms. Researchers develop non-invasive diagnostic tools, wireless ECG/EEG monitoring systems, and optical biosensors for point-of-care disease screening.

researchTracks.title: Biomaterials & Tissue Engineering
researchTracks.subtitle: 3D Bioprinting, Regenerative Medicine, Implants & Drug Delivery
researchTracks.description: Combines polymer science, cell biology, and 3D printing technology to fabricate bio-inspired materials for damaged organ repair, bone defect fillers, and patient-tailored prosthetic implants. Includes targeted nanomedicine for localized drug release with minimal side effects.

researchTracks.title: Health Informatics & AI in Medicine
researchTracks.subtitle: Medical AI/ML, Telemedicine, Wearable Tech & Rehabilitation Robotics
researchTracks.description: Leverages artificial intelligence, computer vision, and IoT connectivity to build intelligent diagnostic assistants, tele-ICU monitoring infrastructure, wearable stroke recovery bands, and assistive exoskeletons for neuro-rehabilitation.

programs.title: B.Tech in Biomedical Engineering
programs.affiliation: School of Engineering & Technology, Adamas University | AICTE Approved
programs.shortDesc: A flagship 4-year undergraduate program combining fundamental engineering principles with biology, medical instrumentation, biomaterials, and clinical healthcare systems.
programs.fullDesc: The B.Tech in Biomedical Engineering at Adamas University equips students with deep interdisciplinary training in electronic instrumentation, human physiology, medical imaging, 3D bioprinting, and bio-AI. Students gain extensive hands-on experience in state-of-the-art department laboratories and undertake clinical internships at leading super-specialty hospitals in Kolkata.

testimonials.quote: The integration of AI modules alongside core biomedical curriculum at Adamas SET is unmatched. I gained deep hands-on expertise in PyTorch and DICOM medical imaging analytics during my capstone project.
